title: Welcome to My Blog

content:
Welcome! This blog is built with Hugo and managed with Nix.
When making this blog/website, my goal was for it to be as lightweight and responsive as possible, while also being easily maintainable and updatable.
Using Github Actions, when changes are made, the blog will automatically be rebuilt and the new build will be pushed to a local SeaweedFS S3 bucket, using self hosted runner on Kubernetes ARC.
Blog content is served via Caddy.
summary: Personal Website built with Hugo + Nix + Github Actions
title: Blog

content:
Introduction # I began using Linux in mid 2018-2019 using an old office computer to host simple utilities such as network attached storage and media sharing utilities such as Jellyfin. Over time it has grown with whatever old technology I could get my hands on.
Currently, I operate a 3 node k3s cluster running under Proxmox VE, with nodes provisoned using Nix Flakes & NixOS anywhere.
Kubernetes # Almost all services are running on the K3s cluster managed by FluxCD. Currently, I use Cert Manager + Lets Encrypt for automatic tls, with Traefik and Cloudflare tunnel to expose services, and MetalLB. At the moment, I use Longhorn to manage persistent storage with replication across nodes.
All secrets are encrypted through SOPS.
Future Planning # I hope to improve my setup as I learn more and have more time. Key considerations:
Terraform to provision nodes, and also finish automating the build process for NixOS nodes using Github Actions Migrate to Rook Ceph Monitoring and observability
summary: Personal homelab used to learn about Linux, Kubernetes and more.
